top.line: Four iPhone and iPad apps from one workspace and an Android tablet app, built by agents in five days.
top.para: 1,164 lines of Swift to 48,230; a signed Android build 4 h 11 after the first commit; a fringe guide on TestFlight in about 10.5 hours.

in-short.line: Four iOS apps, TestFlight on every push, Android from nothing, a fringe guide in a day, many sessions.

ios.line: From a 1,164-line app imported on 7 November to four apps and 48,230 lines by 11 November.
ios.para: PrompTugal, Team, RiskMandate and Lisbon Fringe, with 13 shared packages.

testflight.line: Every push to dev uploaded to TestFlight; a first build approved in about a day.
testflight.para: One rejection for a missing purpose string, fixed in 1 h 25; App Store submission at 23:20 on 8 November.

sessions.line: Seven sessions on separate branches, a conductor merging green branches about once an hour.
sessions.para: Agents from Indi's, Silvio's and my teams.

android.line: A signed Android build on my tablet 4 h 11 after the first commit; 935 commits the next day.
android.para: 33,042 lines of Kotlin, stand mode, an ABP demo and on-device Gemma.

fringe.line: The Lisbon Fringe app: brief at 10:45, valid in TestFlight at 21:11.
fringe.para: 173 events and a filter for events moved by the storm.

lessons.line: Native apps are within reach; ship the pipeline first; shared code pays; the bottleneck moves to machines and stores.

limits.line: Figures from 15 November; approximate commits; one Gemma run.

sources.line: The iOS, Android and Mobile repositories and their sites.
